description: $0.005 via x402: one pre-action heartbeat replaces chain-id + block-tip + block-freshness + gas + fee-history + finality calls. One call covers chain ID + block number + gas, with one round trip and more data. Returns an identity-checked HEALTHY/CONGESTED/STALE verdict across Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, Gnosis and Robinhood Chain.

x_payment.description: signed x402 payment payload (the X-PAYMENT header value) for the terms the first call returns; omit it to get the price and terms
